themes.title: Populist Rally Fever Across Borders
themes.blurb: Right‑wing leaders in the United States and Norway are intensifying rally‑centric campaigning as elections loom, using high‑energy events to mobilize supporters and showcase polling strength.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
